description: Classifier and FDR core vendored from OpenDIAlyzer. 'originals' are the sha256 of the files as they stood at origin.commit; 'files' are the vendored copies (checked by scripts/sync-odia-core.py --check); 'changes' is every deliberate difference from the originals.
changes: LDA only: the gradient-boosted-tree and network learners, bagging, anchor training (seed_mask, bag_fraction, stop_on_composition), disable_cv, the includes of odia_gbt.h and odia_anchor_training.h, and the nested OpenMP set-up with omp_set_max_active_levels are removed. The fold loop is the only parallel region; everything inside a fold runs serially in a fixed order.
Namespace odia::core (ODIA: odia, odia::fdr, odia::lda_detail -> odia::core, odia::core::detail); include guards ODIA_CORE_*; each file carries an SPDX line and its origin.
The target-decoy estimator (lda_detail::assignQValues, RankedGroup) moves from odia_lda.h to odia_fdr.h, and odia_lda.h includes odia_fdr.h (the dependency was the other way round).

scoreSemiSupervisedLDA takes a flat row-major matrix (std::vector<double>, n x m) and std::int64_t group ids instead of vector<vector<double>> and long long, stores groups CSR, and returns LdaResult (was ScoredGroups).
Invalid input throws std::invalid_argument (sizes that do not describe one table; a group whose rows mix target and decoy labels) instead of returning an all-default result.
LdaParams::threads sets the fold-loop team size; results do not depend on it.
Tests: odia_lda_test drops the GBT canonicalisation block and gains a trained-iterations check; all three call the odia::core API.
